thread:
Ivy (CSM): quick post-dry-run for HarborLight. overall looks good but three blockers: egress CIDR narrower than our spec, KMS key policy missing Redwood role, and audit prefixes inconsistent with their SIEM parsing. low severity but need fixes before cutover.

Marta (HarborLight): thanks. infra applied 203.0.113.0/26 instead of the /24 we shared. they only had that allocation.

Ken (Solutions): we can accept an extra /26 to cover the rest, but prefer /24. ask them to add 203.0.113.64/26.

Vik (Eng-Infra): recommended SG egress rule (AWS):
```
Type: All TCP
Protocol: TCP
Port range: 0-65535
Destination: 203.0.113.0/24
```
If they leave only /26 some API calls may drop under load.

Marta (HarborLight): requested the second /26, ETA ~90m.

Dana (SRE): audit forwarder prefixes show `hl-prod` and `hl-debug`. SIEM only matches `hl-prod`. we'll normalize prefixes for cutover.

Ivy (CSM): KMS snippet Vik sent earlier  add our infra role to the key policy with Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey. Marta, please paste and save then confirm. Also marking a medium renewal risk if cutover slips beyond 10 days.

Marta (HarborLight): pasted policy and scheduled rotation for Fri 21:00 local. will post smoke results after /26 is applied.

deploy-bot: Dry-run report: https://deploys.redwood.internal/reports/1758800888  artifacts: net-check.tgz, kms-policy.json, audit-sample.log

Vik (Eng-Infra): i'll run smoke once /26 is up, ETA 2h.

Ivy (CSM): thanks team  please update statuses by EOD. i'll track renewal radar and follow up with AMs.
